title: Generative AI App Developer
description: A roadmap for building AI-powered applications with LLM APIs, RAG, tool use, evaluation, safety, cost control, and production deployment.

tree.name: LLM and App Foundations
tree.description: Understand model capabilities, API calls, prompts, context windows, tokens, latency, cost, and user-facing AI UX.

resources.title: AI Complete OneShot Course for Beginners (Apna College)

children.name: LLM API Basics
children.description: Call chat/completion APIs, stream responses, handle retries, manage keys, estimate cost, and parse structured outputs.

children.name: AI Product UX
children.description: Design loading states, citations, confidence cues, human review, prompt controls, edit flows, and failure recovery.

tree.name: RAG, Tools, and Agents
tree.description: Connect models to private data and tools through retrieval, embeddings, vector databases, function calling, and workflows.

children.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation
children.description: Chunk documents, create embeddings, search vectors, rerank results, cite sources, and debug retrieval quality.

children.name: Tool Calling and Workflows
children.description: Let models call APIs, validate arguments, manage state, recover from tool errors, and keep humans in the loop.

children.name: Practice: RAG Retrieval Debug
children.description: Test chunking, embeddings, retrieval misses, citations, hallucinations, and improve answer grounding.

tree.name: Evaluation, Safety, and Cost
tree.description: Make AI apps reliable through eval datasets, safety checks, monitoring, privacy controls, and cost budgets.

children.name: Evaluation and Regression Tests
children.description: Create golden questions, judge outputs, test hallucination cases, track model changes, and compare prompt versions.

children.name: Safety, Privacy, and Cost Control
children.description: Handle PII, prompt injection, refusals, abuse, caching, rate limits, token budgets, and audit logs.

tree.name: Deployment and Portfolio
tree.description: Deploy AI apps with observability, user feedback, secure secrets, model/version tracking, and documentation.

children.name: AI Observability
children.description: Track prompts, outputs, latency, cost, tool errors, retrieval misses, user ratings, and safety incidents.

children.description: Build a RAG assistant with upload, citations, tool calls, eval set, safety checks, usage dashboard, and deployment notes.
